Objective: Retrieve all distinct molecules mentioned in document CHEMBL1123892, returning chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Only include molecules with canonical_smiles available. Order rows by chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles.

Output: chembl_id, compound_name, canonical_smiles

Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_records, docs, compound_structures

Logic: Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno. Join compound_records to docs on compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1123892' AND compound_structures.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL. Select DISTINCT molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS compound_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Order by molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles.
